profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Solera, Inc. | Full Stack Development
profile.geoLocationName: Mount Laurel, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
With over 12 years of experience in IT, I currently contribute to Solera, Inc. as a Senior Software Engineer, specializing in full-stack development. My expertise includes PHP frameworks, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML, with a focus on creating and managing dynamic web-based applications and Mobile APIs that enhance user experiences.  

At Solera, I collaborate with teams to deliver innovative solutions in web architecture and development. By combining technical proficiency and a commitment to agile methodologies, I aim to support robust and scalable software solutions that align with organizational goals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mount Laurel, New Jersey, United States · Remote
positions.description: Develop and maintain enterprise applications using PHP, JavaScript, Docker, AWS, and MySQL. Design scalable REST APIs and backend services supporting enterprise-grade applications. Manage CI/CD pipelines, GitHub repositories, and containerized deployments. Collaborate within Agile teams using Jira and Confluence. Mentor junior developers and promote engineering best practices. Actively utilize GitHub Copilot and Agentic AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and software delivery.

positions.title: Technology Lead
positions.description: Led enhancement and maintenance of Yii2-based applications. Managed AWS services including EC2, RDS, CloudFront, SES, and Auto Scaling. Reduced infrastructure costs by approximately 40% through optimization.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Delivered applications using Drupal, Joomla, Yii2, and Phalcon. Developed backend systems with PHP, Perl, Python, AngularJS, and MySQL. Supported migrations and modernization initiatives.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented applications using Laravel and CodeIgniter. Partnered with clients to improve functionality and user experience.

positions.title: Technical Analyst/PHP Software developer
positions.description:
- Design and implement web applications using Yii, CakePHP, Core PHP, Laravel.
- Work with CURL  libraries for mobile device management systems or SaaS model of the company.
- Work with front end technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/Jquery.
- Regular Communication/Goto meetings with client for understanding his queries/requirements and taking the whole project responsibility.
- Root cause analysis of the error as required for resolving an error condition.
- Ensured high quality deliverables to the client/user.
- On-time and On-budget deliver

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description: Built enterprise applications using Yii, CakePHP, and Laravel. Performed root-cause analysis and delivered solutions on schedule.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Design and implementation of web application in Core PHP following the company’s coding standard.
- Work with front end technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/Jquery.
- Took sole responsibility of the projects
- Root cause analysis of the error as required for resolving an error condition.

positions.title: Sarvajal
positions.description:
- Created knowledge management website using core PHP, following the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
- Worked with core client to create the web application 
- Created workflows and followed the workflows for the development of web application
